component.name: pgpEncrypt
component.description: Encrypt the input for a recipient using their PGP public key.

component.name: pgpDecrypt
component.description: Decrypt the input using your PGP private key and passphrase.

component.name: pgpStreamEncrypt
component.description: Encrypts a byte stream for a recipient as it passes. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpStreamDecrypt
component.description: Decrypts a byte stream as it passes. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpStreamDecryptAndVerify
component.description: Decrypts a byte stream and verifies the sender's signature, holding it back until the signature is checked. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpStreamSignAndEncrypt
component.description: Signs a byte stream with our key and encrypts it for the recipient, in one pass. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpStreamSign
component.description: Signs a byte stream as it passes, without encrypting it. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpStreamVerify
component.description: Verifies a signed but unencrypted byte stream, holding it back until the signature is checked. Only valid inside a streamSequence.

component.name: pgpSign
component.description: Sign the input with your PGP private key.

component.name: pgpVerify
component.description: Verify a signed message with the sender's PGP public key.

component.name: pgpSignAndEncrypt
component.description: Sign with your private key, then encrypt for the recipient (outbound).

component.name: pgpDecryptAndVerify
component.description: Decrypt with your private key, then verify the sender's signature (inbound).
